build_notes: Build04 startup, static C++ linkage, bounded graphics diagnostics and resizable-window behavior are retained.
The only additional production patch limits the texture capability reported to com.glu.transg1 to min(native_limit, 16384).
This targets a reproduced original-game signed-16-bit sprite clipping overflow; Windows rendering still needs the user's test.
No scale-target, widescreen, original game executable, timer or simulation patches are included.
All nine original app members remain byte-identical; no generated test saves are included.
The parent GUI retains native crash capture and presentation-cap selection. Diagnostics remain enabled via G1_GL_DIAGNOSTICS=1.
